capabilities: Generates a world's description, stability and physics from an age code block
Renders a deterministic linking window and book cover for each Age
Opens Ages as flippable descriptive and linking books
Shelves Ages as books in a Relto refuge island
Adds Imager, telescope and mechanism puzzles in D'ni numerals
disambiguation: Not a tool for writing about ages or dates; an 'Age' here is a Myst-style world described in a code block.
extras: Fan project under Cyan's Fan-Made Content Policy: free, non-commercial, MIT, no Myst assets included. Interface in English and French. Sandbox mode now, game mode planned; mobile support is new and iOS is untested.
motivation: A fan tribute to the Myst series and the Mystcraft idea of linking to a world rather than creating one.
problem: Obsidian gives writers no way to turn a few lines of description into a deterministic world with its own stability verdict, living window, book and shelf.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the Myst series (and the Mystcraft idea of linking to a world rather than creating one).
the Mystcraft idea of linking to a world rather than creating one

summary: Myst-inspired world-writing plugin: an age code block yields a description, stability, animated linking window, book and island refuge.
